title: Enforcement Actions Taken against Agencies Charging Foreign Workers above Cap for Agency Fees
what_it_is: Enforcement Actions Taken against Agencies Charging Foreign Workers above Cap for Agency Fees

sections.label: Employment agency fee rules
sections.summary: MOM caps EA fees at two months' salary, took action against 23 errant EAs from 2015 to 2017, and requires employers to declare salary terms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employment Agencies (EAs) operating in Singapore are not allowed to collect fees exceeding one month of a worker's salary for each year of contracted service here, capped at two months' salary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2015 to 2017, MOM took action against 23 errant EAs for violating this rule.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Three were prosecuted and had their licences revoked while the remaining were given written warnings or had composition fines imposed on them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM also helped the workers who were in Singapore to recover their excess agency fees in full.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While the Ministry has prohibited the EAs in Singapore from charging workers beyond the stipulated fee cap, it is also beyond our jurisdiction to regulate agents in the workers' home countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: When applying for Work Permits, employers are required to declare key salary terms, in particular, basic and fixed monthly salary, and salary deductions, to prospective foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employers are not allowed to increase salary deductions from what is stated in the IPA, unless they have obtained the workers' written agreement and notified MOM of the revisions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Foreign workers who have had their salaries deducted without their written consent, or beyond what is allowable under the law, should report this to MOM as early as possible.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This point will be made clear through the Settling-in Programme which will be rolled out to all new non-Malaysian foreign workers in Singapore starting with those in the construction sector from this year in October 2018.
